claim: For story state the repo proposes 'effect capture': only the host runs story scripts, records each primitive world change, and clients apply that ordered effect list instead of re-running scripts.
evidence: effect-capture-story-sync.md: 'only the host runs story scripts' and clients 'never run the script'; random rolls made once on the host.

sources.location: ## 2. The idea; ## 3. Three kinds of authority

verification_method: Read-only reading of the shallow clone (depth 50) at the stated commit; no code built or run.
limitations: Worked example is Fallout: New Vegas (fnv-coop); whether Shadow of War quest/Nemesis logic can be captured as primitive effects is a HYPOTHESIS.
next_experiment: Inventory Shadow of War story/Nemesis state categories (quest stages, faction members, followers, fortress ownership) as a candidate effect vocabulary, from public sources only.
